notes.title: New Release: "Kokoro Clover SUN" Now Available
notes.content:
Today the newest addition to the “Kokoro Clover” series, “Kokoro Clover SUN - Prehistoric Invaders” has been distributed.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175530/SUN/


This is a special edition based on the theatrical version, depicting the events between "Season 1" and the upcoming "Season 2."

This installment includes:
- 5-minute recap of the story so far
- Special feature episodes 1-4

The screen format has been adjusted to 16:9, with UI improvements, additional anime cuts, sponsor screens, and logo displays to further emphasize the "TV program-style" theme.

Thank you for your continued support of the "Kokoro Clover" series.

Developer: Hikotel

notes.title: "Ver. 4.0" Major Update!
notes.content:
Today, we have updated the game to "Ver.4.0".
This update mainly involves changes to the overall game UI, some character design and illustration adjustments, and various fixes and adjustments.

We apologize for the delay in the update from the initial announcement. We are also diligently working on a new installment in the series, so we appreciate your continued support.

Additionally, we share the latest information about the series on our official Discord. If you encounter any issues, please contact us via the official Discord for support.
https://discord.gg/PDVXMYCejS

Below are the details of this update.

[u][b]Major Changes[/b][/u]

We have changed the logo design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/996339c427afc58dd9394be897d4db4255614941.png[/img]

The version in the top left corner of the title screen has been changed to "Ver.4.0". Please confirm after starting the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/758c9cd6bdbc90c9dac94a4fc3b19d0e92155802.png[/img]
Upon the first startup after the update, you will transition to an unlock information scene before the title screen.

The overall game UI has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/a8e53d2c65ab22b1c6980d5b078940e138eed43f.png[/img]

The opening video has been updated.
https://youtu.be/OJIWCBYYpP8
The commercial video has been updated.
https://youtu.be/-nS9ZwE4ImM

[u][b]Changes Related to Illustrations and Designs[/b][/u]

We have added illustrations for the following characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/6cc141eed4af5845b78870c66298378136fe7db4.png[/img]

We have partially changed the designs of the following characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/44559f32434e534e89549f3b46b83a8005937f83.png[/img]

We have changed the illustrations of the following characters and some others.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/e5d3c61ae9565faa40376e10da2247973e93af98.png[/img]

We have added the following cards:
Treffy (Fire Attribute)
Treffy (Water Attribute)
Treffy (Earth Attribute)
Treffy (Swimsuit)
?
Kokoro Clover SUN
Kokoro Clover SUN2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/eab777effd01105c502643a53d42dc61f6140c37.png[/img]

[u][b]Changes Related to Game Settings[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/674dcdc8cd3359fb74190d6bbb17bd771f82e308.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/6275d674c02d43b220ea080346465a856eb53cb9.png[/img]

You can now select "Story Settings" and "Action Settings" before each episode or stage.

A "No Setting" option has been added to the "Time" setting in "Story Settings".
The "When Defeated in Battle" option has been removed from "Story Settings". Now, when your HP reaches 0 in a scenario, you can choose to skip.

The "Time" and "Subtitle" settings will now be displayed in the upper right corner of "Story Mode".
You can now check the treasure chest acquisition status of the relevant stage when selecting a stage in "Story Mode" and "Adventure Mode".

The time will be displayed in the upper left during stages and boss battles in "Story Mode".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/5005e72e5ade78250cd098d5b045af77386bc4be.png[/img]
The skipping mechanism in "Story Mode" has been changed as follows:
Before: Skipping was displayed after clearing episodes.
After: Skipping is displayed when pressing the "Select Button (N key)". (Skipping is possible even for episodes that have not been cleared)

Minigames can now be skipped.

Clear trophies (silver) will now be displayed for each Boss Rush in "Boss Rush Mode".
*To display the trophies (silver), you need to clear each Boss Rush again. The trophies (gold) for "Boss Rush ALL", which are also displayed on the HOME screen, will be retained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/568a67d187c77e2ac4b910e089c6268c447b2b54.png[/img]

[u][b]Changes to Story Mode Presentation[/b][/u]

We have changed the conversation SE to 4 patterns.

Some transformation anime cuts for Treffy in the following episodes have been partially omitted or removed:
"Episode 1", "Episode 2", "Episode 4"
"Episode 6" during the boss battle

A maid Treffy illustration cut-in has been added to "Episode 3".

A Treffy transformation anime cut has been added before the boss battle in "Episode 6".

Boss cut-ins have been added after the boss transformations in the following episodes:
"Episode 1", "Episode 2", "Episode 3", "Episode 6", "Episode 10", "Episode 11"

An avant-scene has been added to the beginning of "Episode 9".

After clearing "Episode 12", a promotional image for the upcoming new work "Cocoro Clover SUN" has been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/44c02c9a5c6239a63822f9205f488cb4a2c8cce3.png[/img]

Some battle presentations have been removed.

[u][b]Changes Related to Stage Actions[/b][/u]

The timing of when "Shining Treffy" becomes controllable has been changed.
Before: After clearing Episode 6
After: Before the boss battle in Episode 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/138590e34b51d894f46f0534d9998c242ff1dcd8.png[/img]

The special move presentation for the following characters has been partially changed or omitted:
Treffy
Shining Treffy

[b]The specifications for "Support" have been changed as follows:[/b]
Before: Activated at 50% and 100% of the special move gauge
After: Activated manually with the initial setting "L (LB)" button. Recovers assist cost.

[b]The specifications for "Special Moves" have been changed as follows:[/b]
Before: Activated with the "L" button when the special move gauge is MAX
After: Activated with the "L" + "R" buttons when the special move gauge is MAX during boss battles. Deals 50 damage to the boss. (Cannot be activated in normal stages)

A boss battle has been added to the tutorial. An explanation of special moves will occur.

An HP bar has been added to the UI during boss battles.
All bosses' HP and durability have been adjusted.
The "WEAK icon" will now always be displayed when there is a favorable attribute match during boss battles.

The following bosses have been adjusted so they do not move to the left side:
The Vulcander
Valxcyx

[u][b]Addition of English Translations[/b][/u]
English translations have been added to the following:

Game logo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/b00f71ab1ccf54ef5466a27ad37ede66998cc8da.png[/img]

Staff credits displayed at the end of the story and in the option mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/a53fd045c41ada84202f109c3e4c8bc652e7ebdc.png[/img]

Character names in boss cut-ins at the start of boss battles

Various minor bug fixes and adjustments have also been made.

notes.title: Notice of "Ver. 3.2" update.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Kokoro Clover".

We have released "Ver. 3.2" including new player.exe which has increased the amount of memory it can handle.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the repeated updates.

Thank you for your continued support of the "Kokoro Clover" series.

notes.title: Notice of "Ver. 3.1" update.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Kokoro Clover".

In the recent "Ver. 3.0" update, it was discovered that the update was performed with some unnecessary functions installed, resulting in increased processing and memory usage.
Therefore, we will remove the unnecessary functions and re-update the software.
The version will remain "Ver. 3.1" after the re-update.

We apologize for the inconvenience to players who have been experiencing crashes, but please try backing up the "save" file in the "Resources" folder and uninstalling the game once, as this may improve the situation.

In addition, games created with "Action Game Toolkit MV" may fail to start due to dll errors or insufficient DLLs.
In this case, please refer to the following FAQ for "Action Game Toolkit MV" and install the Microsoft Visual C++ package.
[url=https://tkool.jp/support/faq_actmv.html]https://tkool.jp/support/faq_actmv.html[/url]

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We look forward to your continued support of the "Kokoro Clover" series.

notes.title: Artwork distribution and next update
notes.content:
We've added a data version of the "Kokoro Clover Season 1 Design Works" that was previously distributed at the game event as DLC! It contains illustrations and dots for each character, so be sure to check it out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/70c21d0e812c4fdb42bccae1810d3b9f16b108b8.png[/img].

In addition, a "Ver. 3.0" update will be scheduled for early 2023 (January or February).
Ver. 3.0" will be an update mainly aimed at adjusting the Switch version.


In order to run the Switch version at 60FPS, we plan to reduce the size of the stages for the Switch version only.
Therefore, please note that from "Ver. 3.0" onward, the content of the stages will differ between the Steam version and the Switch version.
We also hope to adjust the stages in the Steam version accordingly.
In addition, we plan to enhance various stages and functional aspects of the game.


Current update schedule.
Mainly, we are planning to update the stages of the Switch version.
Event stills will be added to some stories.
A feature that will allow users to skip the "OP video at startup", "story settings", "action settings", etc. in the "Option Mode".
A function to change "Story Settings" and "Action Settings" in "Option Mode".

We have received reports of a problem with the screen size returning to its original size when the screen size is set to full window, but we hope you understand that this is probably due to a bug in the production tools and that it is difficult to fix. This game is recommended to be played in windowed mode.


If you have any other reports of bugs or features you would like to see added, please contact us via the official discord, etc. (http://discord.gg/dzBc6aQVfJ)


Thank you very much for your support in 2022. We will continue to develop "Season 2" and look forward to working with you again next year.

Developer Hikotel

notes.title: Update, "ver2.2"!
notes.content:
"Kokoro Clover Season1" has been updated to "ver2.2" from 2022/12/23! (JST)

[u]The update is as follows! [/u]

Fixed a bug that the dance "Guru Guru" of "Kaito Bavarois" could be moved left and right.

Fixed a bug that the silhouette of "Boss Rush Mode" did not change when it was not opened.

We hope you continue to enjoy "Kokoro Clover Season1"!

Developer Hikotel

notes.title: Update, "ver2.1"!
notes.content:
"Kokoro Clover Season1" has been updated to "ver2.1" from 2022/11/16! (JST)

(Please wait for a while for the Switch version.)

[u]The update is as follows![/u]

・The additional translation was incomplete and has been corrected to that of the original translator.

・When only the cross key is pressed during a dance, the dance is now canceled.

・Adjusted the state of continuous audio when attacking in succession during one jump of the treffy.

We hope you continue to enjoy "Kokoro Clover Season1"!

Developer Hikotel

notes.title: "Ver. 2.0" update!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. We have updated the game to "Ver. 2.0" which includes additional characters and bug fixes.

Please wait for a while for the Switch version.
We will also be increasing the fps setting from "fixed 30" to "60" for the Steam version only, and we apologize that the Switch version cannot be changed due to the specifications of the production tools.


Please note that after the update, the dotted characters on the title screen will increase and the version in the upper right corner will change from "1.0" to "2.0".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/e1a31b2ae3ecb5d30ed2769f0e748637d8cfbfaf.png[/img].

(1) Added "Phantom Thief Black Cherry" as an operating character.
It can be unlocked in the store after all characters have been opened in the story and store.
The earliest character can be unlocked is after viewing the 12th episode of the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/9fbad60d6b9317727421d570de2508f40d210263.png[/img].

(2) Added character skins that can be set on the HOME screen.
Skins with "seasonal" themes for the main characters will be added.
The additional skins will also switch to a special randomly generated comment.
Additional skins will also be added to the library mode gallery.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/8a05f8b4a391bf7b79779497746aa4ee233d340d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/7f0bf21fe25abd1ee9e8f9570f5fcf023543a088.png[/img]

(3) Major improvements to actions.
The maximum fps setting has been changed from "30 fixed" to "60" only for the STEAM version.
・Changed the action from "Move" to "Dance" directly.
Shining Treffy" can now generate a shockwave when attacking at long range.
The basic attack power of "Shining Treffy" was increased.
The aerial spinning attack of "Shining Treffy" has been modified so that it can be used in succession.
The "WEAK icon" is now displayed next to the boss icon if there is an affinity advantage during boss battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/f1b38e9f7a06f3a2392f10503ef212dd9c0daf79.png[/img]
Random attacks by the boss "Bombadillo" have been changed to fixed for the first two attacks only.

The following new elements have been added and changed.
Some cuts in the open video have been corrected.
・Added a scene that displays the contents unlocked before HOME when the game is launched for the first time, in Story mode, Adventure mode, and when Boss Rush ALL is cleared, only once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/3ff014551508e62d1cbb3dfbc90f5b784426b11d.png[/img]
∙ Changed to display the unlocked information in the comment field of stages etc. that have not been unlocked in each mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/341c17df49cba640f98706a39e1e9f8573bf0622.png[/img]
∙ Changed the condition for unlocking the assist "Sully" from "Boss Rush ALL clear" to "3 episodes viewed".


5) In addition, the following bugs and other issues will be fixed. (A sampling of some of the problems that have been causing inconvenience)
The random text of "Skol," "Cherry," and "The Vul-Can-Do" on the HOME screen is not in English.
The random comments of "Treffy" and "Momo" are not displayed on the HOME screen.
Improvement of the phenomenon that comments and backgrounds disappear momentarily when they are changed on the HOME screen.
A bug in the first episode of the story mode where the player is stuck in a wall.
A bug that the card names and images of "Valxcyx" and "Dark Shark" are different in the card mode.
A bug in the store assistant "King Plushward": the number of coins required to obtain it is not "30" but "20.
A bug that the background music of the Bouncy Barker icon cannot be played in the music mode.

In addition, minor changes have been made to the game and bugs have been fixed to make it more enjoyable.



Future plans for "Season 1" include the addition of digital versions of the "artwork" that will be distributed at events. We hope you will check the official Kokoro Clover discord for regular updates.
We will continue to make every effort to ensure that you enjoy the Kokoro Clover series, and we thank you in advance for your continued support.

Developer Hikotel

notes.title: Ver. 2.0" update notice!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/2951a759d9f640757e9a49715a9f3669222960d7.png[/img]
We plan to update the game to "Ver. 2.0" before fall or winter.
This will be an addition of operating characters and improvement of actions and glitches.


After the update, the number of dotted characters on the title screen will increase and the version in the upper right corner will change from "1.0" to "2.0".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/e1a31b2ae3ecb5d30ed2769f0e748637d8cfbfaf.png[/img]

(1) "Phantom Thief Black Cherry" is added to the operating characters.
It can be unlocked in the store after all characters have been opened in the story and store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/9fbad60d6b9317727421d570de2508f40d210263.png[/img]


2) New character skins that can be set on the HOME screen.
Seasonal-themed skins for the main characters will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609489/dfd2350ea5f709754d074ec7cc806dbecc439fd1.png[/img]
(3) Improved actions.
The "Shining Treffy" will have a long-range attack, and a "WEAK icon" will be displayed during boss battles if the player has an advantage in chemistry.



The following bugs and other issues will also be fixed. (A few examples of problems that have been causing inconvenience are as follows.)
The random text of "Skoll", "Cherry" and "The Vul-Can-Do" on the HOME screen is not in English.
A bug in the story mode in the first story stage, where the player is stuck in a wall.
A bug that the card names and images of "Valxcyx" and "Dark Shark" are different in the card mode.
A bug in the store assistant "King Plushward": the number of coins required to obtain it is not "30" but "20.
A bug that the background music of the Bouncy Barker icon could not be played in the music mode.

Other display bugs will be fixed.



We will continue to make every effort to ensure that you enjoy the "Kokoro Clover" series.

Developer Hikotel
